subject: Autumn TB testing schedule — Lochcarron cluster
snippet: Craig, sending through the provisional dates for the autumn round.
body:
Craig,

Sending through the provisional dates for the autumn TB testing round across the Lochcarron cluster. First herd is Achnasheen on 1 October. Can you confirm the running order for the 28 herds so I can log it our end?

Regards,
Rhona Matheson
APHA Veterinary Inspector

subject: Re: Autumn TB testing schedule — Lochcarron cluster
snippet: Rhona, running order attached. Achnasheen first, then Torridon.
body:
Rhona,

Running order works. Achnasheen first on 1 October, then the Torridon and Applecross herds through to mid-November, remote Sutherland to close. Completion before the 20 November reporting deadline.

Craig

subject: Re: Autumn TB testing schedule — Lochcarron cluster
snippet: Logged. I will send the pre-movement paperwork nearer the time.
body:
Logged our end. I will send the pre-movement paperwork nearer the time. Thanks Craig.

Rhona

subject: Order confirmation MWI-558207
snippet: Thank you for your order. Dispatch expected next working day.
body:
Dear Mr Figueroa,

Thank you for your order MWI-558207. Items: Alamycin LA 100ml x6, Metacam 20mg/ml 100ml x4, lambing gloves 2 boxes, sterile suture pack x10.

Dispatch expected next working day by UPS. Total £312.40 ex VAT.

MWI Animal Health

subject: Re: Order confirmation MWI-558207
snippet: Received, thanks. Hold the next oxytetracycline order until I confirm stock.
body:
Received, thanks. Hold the next oxytetracycline order until I confirm fridge stock after this week's calvings.

Craig Figueroa
Figueroa Veterinary Services

subject: Ewe off her feet — top field
snippet: Craig, got a ewe down in the top field this morning, not getting up.
body:
Craig,

Got a ewe down in the top field this morning, not getting up and the others have moved on. Twin lambs at foot. Can you get out today?

Duncan

subject: Re: Ewe off her feet — top field
snippet: On my way, with you by half nine. Keep the lambs close to her.
body:
On my way, with you by half nine. Keep the lambs close to her and out of the wind. Sounds like staggers, I will bring calcium and magnesium.

Craig

subject: Re: Ewe off her feet — top field
snippet: She is up and grazing this evening. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
body:
She is up and grazing this evening, lambs sucking. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Invoice to the usual address.

Duncan

subject: Self-assessment — Q4 figures
snippet: Craig, ahead of the January return can you send the Q4 income and the drug stock spend.
body:
Craig,

Ahead of the January return, can you send the Q4 practice income figures and the drug stock spend? I want to check the 30% set-aside is tracking before year end.

Douglas Mackay
Mackay & Co

subject: Re: Self-assessment — Q4 figures
snippet: Douglas, figures attached. Income held around the £5,200 monthly average.
body:
Douglas,

Figures attached. Income held around the £5,200 monthly average, drug stock spend a touch higher with the lambing run. Set-aside is on track.

Craig

subject: Highland Veterinary Congress 2026 — booking confirmed
snippet: Your delegate place for 14-16 October is confirmed.
body:
Dear Craig Figueroa,

Your delegate place for the Highland Veterinary Congress, Harrogate, 14-16 October 2026 is confirmed. Stream: bovine reproductive ultrasonography. Delegate fee £345 paid.

We look forward to seeing you.

subject: Practice cover — Harrogate week
snippet: Graeme, can you cover 13-17 October? Congress in Harrogate.
body:
Graeme,

Can you cover the practice 13-17 October? I am at the Harrogate congress that week. Calving should be quiet, autumn TB round will have started so a couple of Achnasheen reads may land, I will leave notes.

Craig

subject: Mare due a check
snippet: Craig, the grey mare's foot is troubling her again.
body:
Craig,

The grey mare's near hind foot is troubling her again, weight off it in the mornings. Could you look when you are next out Applecross way?

Iain

subject: Re: Mare due a check
snippet: Out your way Thursday for the Applecross round, I will bring the hoof testers.
body:
Out your way Thursday for the Applecross round. I will bring the hoof testers and we will check for an abscess. Keep her on the dry standing till then.

Craig

subject: Norway — September?
snippet: Had a look at flights to Tromso. Late September looks open for both of us.
body:
Craig,

Had a look at flights to Tromso for the trip. Late September looks open for both of us before your TB round kicks off. Shall I hold a couple of dates?

Fi x

subject: Re: Norway — September?
snippet: Hold the last week of September. I will square the on-call with Graeme.
body:
Hold the last week of September. I will square the on-call with Graeme. Long overdue.

C x

subject: Sofia's party — 24th
snippet: Sofia's birthday party here in Plockton on the 24th, 2pm.
body:
Craig,

Sofia's birthday party here in Plockton on the 24th October, 2pm. She is asking if Uncle Craig is coming. Bring Fiona. Diego wants to show you the boat with Callum.

Isabel

subject: Re: Sofia's party — 24th
snippet: Wouldn't miss it. We will be there for two.
body:
Wouldn't miss it. We will be there for two. Tell Sofia I am coming. I will square the afternoon round earlier in the week.

Craig

subject: Picking your brains — retained cleansing
snippet: Jean, suckler cow three days post-calving, retained cleansing.
body:
Jean,

Suckler cow at the Torridon place, three days post-calving with a retained cleansing, mild temperature this morning. Holding off systemic antibiotics for now. Would value your read when you have a minute.

Craig

subject: Re: Picking your brains — retained cleansing
snippet: Sounds like you are on the right line. Do not pull it.
body:
Sounds like you are on the right line. Do not pull it. Keep her under review, cover only if the temperature climbs. Ring me if she goes off.

Jean

subject: Defender service due
snippet: Your Land Rover Defender is due its quarterly service.
body:
Dear Mr Figueroa,

Your Land Rover Defender (mobile clinic) is due its quarterly service and fridge unit check. We have slots the week of 25 May. Please reply to book.

Strathpeffer Land Rover
